name: Randolph Township Summer Day Camp
operator_name: Randolph Township Parks, Recreation and Community Services
description_short: Seven week township day camp at Freedom Park for children who finished kindergarten to grade 5, with sports, games, crafts, special events, guest visits and two trips a week to Randolph Lake.
refund_policy_summary: Refunds must be requested in writing; requests by June 1 are refunded less a $25 fee per child per week, and nothing is refunded after June 1.
notes: Prices are the non-resident rate when registering January 5 to February 27: $250 a week, rising to $270 from March 1 and $290 from May 1. Resident rate $225 a week (then $245 and $265); residents taking all seven weeks pay $160 a week. Morning care 7 to 9 am and after care 3 to 6 pm cost extra (non-residents $40 and $50 a session; residents $25 and $35 a week). Camp 9 am to 3 pm. Free lunch on Fridays; lunch can be bought Monday to Thursday. Trips cost extra. No camp Friday July 3. Township schools are used in bad weather. Teen Travel Camp (grades 6 to 8, residents) and Artworks summer art camps are listed separately.
